# `^FP` – Field Parameter

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Sets the field direction and additional inter-character gap for text fields.

Reference parameters: **d, g**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 202](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
